REQUEST TO PURCHASE OVER$35,000.00
The City of Cheyenne requests to purchase in-car and body-worn camera systems, components
and peripheral devices and related software and support service for the Police Department from
Watch Guard, Allen, TX in the amount of $769,647.00.This is a single source purchase;
therefore, no bids were requested.
This will be reviewed by City Council at Finance on June 18,2018 and voted on at the June 25,
2018 City Council meeting.
If you have any questions, please call Sara Vasquez at 307/637-6345.
Sara Vasquez
Purchasing Manager
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WY
